Examples: ``| `bin/deploy` | `scripts/legacy` is the old path |`` and "| `scripts/a.sh` | `origin/main` mirror |". `extract_plan_file_path_sets` then marks that token as strong.
  WHY: With no planning root (the poller), the token goes to `ungrantable`. This causes a `plan_path_not_grantable` hold or re-plan, and a likely maintainer hold. With a root (plan.yml `--planning-root "$(pwd)"`), the reviewers disagree. openai_gpt-6-luna, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say a regular file under the root gets an exact grant that widens implement scope. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says lines 1075-1076 already grant such files regardless of listing, so the change only adds holds: the strong branch skips the `_plan_tree_real_dir` guard and holds tokens like `origin/main` or `actions/checkout@v5`. The new tests do not pin the description-cell case. Severity also differs: MAJOR from openai_gpt-6-luna, NIT from the other three. The highest is kept and mapped to high.

Examples: "| `scripts/a.sh` | `origin/main` mirror |" and "| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | `actions/checkout@v5` bump |". _PLAN_GRANT_SEGMENT_RE (line 815) allows "@", so these tokens pass _plan_grant_extensionless_candidate and are marked strong.   WHY: A common "File | Change" table now produces a plan_path_not_grantable hold that a re-plan is likely to repeat, ending in a maintainer hold (the stall #9130 set out to remove). The reviewer says the claim that the grant widens is not correct: lines 1075-1076 already grant extensionless regular files under the root, so the change fails safe and only adds holds. Suggested fix (about 3 lines): count a "|" gap as a joiner only when the span fills the whole cell.
